brief.title: Discovery call — Housekeeping task management system — 4 Mar 2026
business_goals: We need room status and task assignment to move onto a mobile system the housekeepers can use directly.
When a guest checks out, the room needs to automatically appear as "dirty" and get assigned to a housekeeper based on their current workload, not just whoever's next on a list.
Housekeepers need a simple app on a handheld device to mark a room as in-progress, then clean, then ready for inspection.
It has to work without needing a strong signal — a lot of our stairwells and back corridors have terrible WiFi.
constraints: We're aiming to launch this before the year-end peak season in December, and ownership has approved a budget of SGD 150,000 for the initial rollout across all three properties.
open_questions: Which metric defines success for launch?

requirements.evidence: We need room status and task assignment to move onto a mobile system the housekeepers can use directly.

requirements.evidence: When a guest checks out, the room needs to automatically appear as "dirty" and get assigned to a housekeeper based on their current workload, not just whoever's next on a list.

requirements.evidence: Housekeepers need a simple app on a handheld device to mark a room as in-progress, then clean, then ready for inspection.

requirements.statement: The system shall It has to work without needing a strong signal — a lot of our stairwells and back corridors have terrible WiFi.
requirements.evidence: It has to work without needing a strong signal — a lot of our stairwells and back corridors have terrible WiFi.

requirements.statement: The system shall Rooms marked "ready for inspection" should notify a supervisor automatically, and the supervisor needs to approve it before the room shows as available for the front desk to sell again.
requirements.evidence: Rooms marked "ready for inspection" should notify a supervisor automatically, and the supervisor needs to approve it before the room shows as available for the front desk to sell again.

requirements.statement: The system shall Room status changes have to sync with Opera in both directions — if front desk marks a room out of order in Opera, housekeeping should see that immediately, and vice versa.
requirements.evidence: Room status changes have to sync with Opera in both directions — if front desk marks a room out of order in Opera, housekeeping should see that immediately, and vice versa.

requirements.statement: The system shall We get a lot of same-day requests — a guest wants late checkout, or an early check-in needs a room rushed.
requirements.evidence: We get a lot of same-day requests — a guest wants late checkout, or an early check-in needs a room rushed.

requirements.statement: The system shall For VIP guests, there's a checklist that's different from standard rooms — turndown service, specific amenity placement — housekeepers should see that VIP checklist automatically when the room is tagged VIP in Opera.
requirements.evidence: For VIP guests, there's a checklist that's different from standard rooms — turndown service, specific amenity placement — housekeepers should see that VIP checklist automatically when the room is tagged VIP in Opera.

requirements.statement: The system shall Lost and found is a constant headache — when a housekeeper finds an item, they should be able to log it with a photo right from the same app, tagged to the room number and date.
requirements.evidence: Lost and found is a constant headache — when a housekeeper finds an item, they should be able to log it with a photo right from the same app, tagged to the room number and date.

requirements.statement: The system shall On performance, room status changes need to reflect across all devices within 15 seconds — if two housekeepers are near the same room, we don't want them both walking in.
requirements.evidence: On performance, room status changes need to reflect across all devices within 15 seconds — if two housekeepers are near the same room, we don't want them both walking in.

requirements.statement: The system shall Minibar restocking and billing is out of scope for this project — that's handled by a separate F&B system already, we don't want to touch that.
requirements.evidence: Minibar restocking and billing is out of scope for this project — that's handled by a separate F&B system already, we don't want to touch that.

requirements.statement: The system shall at least one year of room status and inspection history retained, mainly so Rooms can pull data for quality audits.
requirements.evidence: We need at least one year of room status and inspection history retained, mainly so Rooms can pull data for quality audits.
